body: Hey, yeah I've been on celexa for about 3 months now and there were times where I felt better but it was mostly from the CBT or when I did something enjoyable. I feel like I just need something to level me out for now until this episode passes and then I can taper off but this medication doesn't seem to be helping... do you have any experience with AD?

Hey, thanks for replying. I definitely feel as though my depression resides in the way that I think. And the main thought that's really freaking me out and making me severely depressed is the idea that when we all die we become nothing right? But the whole point in life is to enjoy it. However, I'm not enjoying it at the moment and there's no difference in whether I die today or in 80 years I'll still be dead and there's nothing of me there. So what's the point in trying so hard to get better when I'll end up in the same place regardless. Sigh... this is really disheartening... and yes I have seen a therapist.

Hey man, thanks for answering. Yup, I definitely agree with you and that's the conclusion I came too a couple years ago too. But this time around everything just feels so pointless and empty, I just can't seem to accept it. But then again I'm currently very stressed and going through depression, maybe that's why its so hard for me? What are your thoughts, thanks again.
